snippet.title: How to Start an LLC in Texas in 15 Minutes (2026)
snippet.description:
Learn how to start an LLC in Texas, step by step. From choosing your LLC name to keeping it in good standing, this is your guide.
✅ Northwest Registered Agent (Best Deal): https://meticsmedia.com/northwest-ATT

Starting an LLC in Texas is more straightforward than most people think, and this guide walks you through the entire process from start to finish. I show you exactly how to choose a compliant Texas LLC name, use the SOSDirect business name search, and check for trademarks before you commit.

From there, I explain what a registered agent is, why most people use a service instead of doing it themselves, and why Northwest Registered Agent is the option I recommend. Then I walk you through the full Northwest filing process screen by screen, including how to get your EIN, what the optional add-ons actually mean, and which ones make sense for most beginners.

We also cover creating your operating agreement, opening a business bank account, and what Texas specifically requires to keep your LLC in good standing each year.

snippet.title: $30K/month founder reveals exactly what is inside his AI peptide app
snippet.description:
Cedric is a college student who built PepAI and hit $50K in revenue in 7 weeks. $11K MRR, ~2,000 active subs, $10/mo or $45/yr with a 3-day trial.

The stack is dead simple:

Repl.it + Claude to vibe code the whole thing in ~2 weeks
Firebase for backend + user data
RevenueCat for in-app subscriptions
Resend for email
PubMed sources powering the research library
Apple Health for the lifestyle + tracking layer

The real edge wasn’t the tech. It was spotting peptides trending on TikTok before anyone shipped a serious app for it, then moving fast.

snippet.title: He built a $25K/month app in one week using Cursor. Here's his entire tech stack
snippet.description:
Kyan is 21, still in college, and shipped his first app ever 5 months ago. Now ToneAdapt has 100K+ users and pulls $25K/mo.

His stack is dead simple:

Cursor + Claude Code for all the code (vibe-coded, zero lines written by hand)
Supabase for database
Vercel for hosting + backend API routes
Stripe for payments on the web app
RevenueCat for mobile subscriptions
Superwall for paywalls + A/B testing
OpenAI API + Tavily web search API
Mailgun for emails
Swift native for the iOS app

The website did $11.5K and the mobile app did $14K in the last 4 weeks alone.

snippet.title: n8n and Zapier Are Dead. Build Automations Like This Instead.
snippet.description:
If you're still building automations in n8n or Zapier, you're way behind. Here's how easy it is to build the same automation in Claude Code.

First, an AgentOS folder. Just a folder on my machine where Claude Code lives, with all my context, tools, and memory files.

Then I connect the tool I want to automate. For this one I drop a Fathom API key into my .env file.

Next, I describe the automation in plain English. Claude saves that as a skill. The skill is just a text file. That text file is the entire automation.

Last, I create a routine that triggers the skill on a schedule. Daily at 9am. Done.

No nodes, no canvas, no broken connectors at 2am.

Comment AgentOS if you want help setting this up.

#claudecode #automation #n8n #zapier #aiagents
